purpose: append-only longitudinal team and player outcome effects from the verified Panthers v Roosters qualifying final

observations: Advanced to a seventh-straight preliminary final.
Recovered from a 12-6 deficit and entered halftime level 12-12.
Conceded no points during Nathan Cleary's second-half sin-bin period.
Reversed the Round 24 same-venue 12-6 loss to the Roosters in the qualifying final.
Panthers.macro_effect: Positive finals-resilience observation. Preserve separately from the pre-match structural baseline; do not convert one result into a universal clutch or venue rule.

observations: Led 12-6 during the first half and entered halftime level 12-12.
Did not score during Penrith's one-man disadvantage after Nathan Cleary's sin-bin.
Will host the Sharks in a sudden-death Week 2 final next Saturday night according to the official NRL post-match report.
Roosters.macro_effect: Qualifying-final loss added to longitudinal form. The failure to convert the numerical advantage is an observed match fact, not by itself proof of a persistent attacking mechanism.

observations: Sin-binned late in the first half.
Kicked the 72nd-minute field goal for a 13-12 lead.
Official NRL report noted a late leg issue; future availability effect remains UNKNOWN pending new official evidence.
Nathan Cleary.causal_limit: No post-kickoff event may retrospectively justify the pre-match selection.

observations: Scored the 78th-minute try that extended Penrith's lead beyond a converted try.
Converted the late Brian To'o try while Cleary was affected by a late leg issue.
Failed an HIA during the first half.
Left the field for an HIA in the 72nd minute.

statistics_refresh.rule: Do not infer unpublished final player-stat fields. Refresh official per-round statistical dossiers when stable official profile/match data is available.
